question_en: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)

requested answer roles and fields.original_quote: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)
requested answer roles and fields.independent_derivation: The original English asks which specifications the recent CRs modify and explicitly labels the task change-to-spec mapping. A mapping preserves the source CR identity and target specification identity, rather than only a deduplicated list of targets. This is independently consistent with Phase3 CQ3-1 CR→Spec (L174-183) and its relationship-tracing purpose (L23-28). It does not ask for title, approval, normative clause, an aggregate count or rank.
requested answer roles and fields.query_evidence: RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber; both required string/non-null fields; no additional output role
requested answer roles and fields.assessment: pass: the two named fields are the requested association. Required CR identity is justified by the explicit mapping task, not merely by its presence in the old RETURN. The spec-only alternative would erase which recent CR maps to which target.

counting unit and join multiplicity.original_quote: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)
counting unit and join multiplicity.independent_derivation: A change-to-spec mapping consists of CR-document/target-spec pairs. Multiple CR documents may map to one specification and remain distinct requested associations. Phase1 L939 explicitly permits multiple target values; neither an assumed single-spec functional dependency nor global DISTINCT is licensed. The original query returns relationship join occurrences without aggregation or DISTINCT. Required string identity is retained on both sides.
counting unit and join multiplicity.query_evidence: one returned row per CR–MODIFIES–Spec occurrence; no DISTINCT, collect, count or target-only collapse; unordered multiset contract
counting unit and join multiplicity.assessment: pass: multiset faithfully preserves the original association occurrences while avoiding an unsupported serialization-order requirement. At the observed selected frontier the formal register and seven own covers show one target per selected CR; this observation is not promoted to a global uniqueness axiom.

cardinality and completeness.original_quote: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)
cardinality and completeness.independent_derivation: Recent is a bounded list request in preserved evaluation context. The exact authored instance fixes five mapping rows. Generic design default10 (Phase3 L221-228) is real opposing context, but a default does not replace the already instantiated five in the unchanged original query. This is not a new extent chosen by the repair. Independent raw replay reopened85 physical workbooks in the documented35-meeting domain:62092 identities, eight unique cutoff-or-later documents in32 version rows; five in-domain CRs, two38.903 CRs, one work plan. Every seven formal CR own cover agrees with its literal target.
cardinality and completeness.query_evidence: ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5; cardinality all means every row of this complete selected-five result, not every unbounded mapping
cardinality and completeness.assessment: pass for this authored instantiated extent: every selected mapping must be returned. No claim that five is a universal definition of recent or that all34586 unbounded rows are mandatory. Generic10 and unrestricted-English alternatives remain documented; replacing five with ten or all would change this existing instance rather than repair its scoring.

ordering and ties when requested.independent_derivation: The original validation explicitly states TDoc/CR document number DESC means latest documents first (L132-141). This matches recent and the exact authored cr.tdocNumberDESC. The generic CQ3 MeetingDESC/CRnumberASC design table (L213-218) is a competing default; the instantiated recency query and validation document rule are more specific here. It is documentary recency, not upload timestamp, cover date or approval date. A mapping list does not independently demand ranked answer serialization.
ordering and ties when requested.query_evidence: ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT5 selects the prefix; collection.kind multiset permits any serialization of the same selected associations
ordering and ties when requested.assessment: pass: retain the selection order and five while scoring an unordered multiset. No secondary target sort is invented. No equal-cutoff alternate target row was observed in the source frontier; this claim is bounded to the actual instance, not all future graphs.
